installCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; elif [ -f el-favor-bitacora/package.json ]; then npm --prefix el-favor-bitacora install; else echo 'No package.json found.'; exit 1; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build; elif [ -f el-favor-bitacora/package.json ]; then npm --prefix el-favor-bitacora run build; else echo 'No package.json found.'; exit 1; fi
